description: Small example of Stage 4.1 outputs: the window manifest and cache, and the matched TSS 4-mer feature table.

outputs.contents: Tracked manifest: transcript, strand, TSS, genomic span, N padding, cDNA prefix and sha256 per window.
One cached FASTA window per gene, gene orientation, TSS at index 98,304.
The CDS metadata table with x replaced by 4-mer composition over the matched TSS window.
